critical_code_review_comments: Semantic mismatch: _public_evq() filters events by {status:Approved/Scheduled, published:True, archived:False}, but _is_public_file() for events checks {image_file_id, public:True}. These are DIFFERENT fields — `public` is a user-set flag on EventIn (default False), while `published` is toggled by /events/{id}/publish. So a staff can /publish an event with image_file_id, see it in /public/events, yet the hero image will still 404 from /public/files unless the creator also ticked `public:true` at creation. Recommend aligning _is_public_file event check to _public_evq (status Approved/Scheduled + published True + archived != True) OR have /events/{id}/publish also set public:True. Currently only tests that set public:true in the create payload get the image to serve.
server.py now 3357 lines — grew again with EventUpdate + gallery endpoints. Split events/gallery into their own modules soon.

_backfill_gallery runs on every startup and inserts N photos serially; idempotent per (file_id, event_id) but O(events*reports*photos) unbatched — fine at current data volume, but consider one aggregation pipeline or a flag on the report doc to skip already-backfilled reports.

Non-owner/non-staff PUT /events/{id} returns 403 correctly, but there is no state guard: staff can edit events that are already 'Completed' or 'Declined' with no audit-visible warning. Fine for correction workflow, but consider preventing edits to Declined events.

_add_gallery_photos: default_status logic uses submitter_role in STAFF_ROLES — but during _backfill_gallery submitter_role is passed as None so the default_status fallback (approved if ev.public else pending) drives the decision. Historical staff-submitted reports on non-public events get backfilled as 'pending' which may need a one-time script to auto-approve.

GalleryReview.jsx uses /files/{id}/download for thumbnails (authenticated route). That is fine for staff review, but means images won't render if session cookie is missing. Consider /public/files fallback when the photo is already approved.

rca of the issue: Not a live regression, but a potential future bug: when a staff edits an event to add image_file_id AND toggles publish, the /public/events listing shows the event, but the hero image /public/files/{fid} returns 404 unless public:true is set. Two-way fix options: (a) unify _is_public_file event predicate with _public_evq (status Approved/Scheduled + published + not archived), or (b) have publish_event set public:True.
